title: 6100 Bahama Shores Dr S
subtitle: Waterfront Custom Estate — "The Vistara" in Bahama Shores
description:
Positioned along one of St. Petersburg's most coveted deepwater enclaves, 6100 Bahama Shores Drive South presents a rare opportunity to acquire 'The Vistara' — a bespoke 4,376-square-foot coastal modern waterfront residence on an expansive 0.51-acre homesite with approximately 90 feet of direct Tampa Bay frontage.

Architecturally conceived to capture panoramic open-water vistas and sunrise-to-sunset horizons over Tampa Bay and the Sunshine Skyway Bridge, the estate seamlessly unites elevated hurricane-resilient engineering with resort-caliber indoor-outdoor living. A private four-stop commercial-grade elevator connects the ground-level 3+ car tandem motor court through two levels of refined living quarters up to an expansive rooftop sky lounge complete with a custom wet bar and observation terrace.

All pre-construction structural engineering, soil borings, architectural blueprints, and seawall due diligence have been meticulously completed, allowing discerning buyers to customize final interior finishes while bypassing years of entitlement and design delays.

title: NE 90th Street Rd
subtitle: 19.72-Acre Gated Old Florida Agricultural & Timberland Sanctuary
description:
Spanning 19.72 acres (858,823 square feet) of pristine, mature-timbered land in Marion County's renowned equestrian and conservation belt, this gated tract on NE 90th Street Road offers genuine Old Florida seclusion just minutes from the Ocala National Forest and the Ocklawaha River.

Blanketed in merchantable pine and native hardwood canopy, the parcel carries flexible A-1 General Agriculture zoning with zero HOA restrictions and zero CDD assessments. Whether envisioned as a multi-structure family compound, private equestrian estate, working agricultural homestead, merchantable timber harvest, or long-term land bank in one of North Central Florida's fastest-appreciating rural corridors, the site provides an extraordinary natural canvas.

The property is secured via a heavy-duty gated entrance equipped with active motion-sensor security alarms and cellular trail cameras, preserving complete privacy and untouched natural topography.
